products.name: Cognigy
products.note: Conversational AI platform for customer service; GDPR-compliant; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Cognigy, headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, describes itself as a provider of enterprise customer service AI, operating under the name NiCE Cognigy. The company positions its platform as a way for organizations to deploy AI agents across voice and chat channels within contact center environments, with the stated goal of delivering fast and personalized service. Its platform incorporates both generative and conversational AI approaches.

The company's tracked product is listed under the Enterprise AI Platforms and Agent Orchestration category, described as a conversational AI platform for customer service that is GDPR-compliant and offers EU-hosted deployment options. The held facts show 11 points of Delaware legal exposure, indicating a meaningful footprint in Delaware-related legal or corporate filings, though no specific litigation cases are recorded.
